Aug sales of NT$64.2bn (+32.4% MoM, +44.1% YoY), tracking 71.5% of UBSe in
Q3.
OUR TAKE:
QTD sales is tracking to high end of Q3 guide of flat to +5% QoQ. Sept sales should
sustain strength with price hike and new flagship 5G SoC, on top of new product
ramp of smart edge. TPU v8t on track for HVM from late Q3 for >US$2bn sales in
2026.

We already lifted our estimates for Mediatek in our Semicon Taiwan report to reflect its 
stronger ASIC growth potential. Maintain our Buy rating and PO at NT$5,230 on 23x
2H27-1H28E P/E. We think shares are attractive at 23x 2H27-1H28E P/E (vs. its
historical P/E range of 8-25x) with re-rating catalyst from ASIC NRE and turnkey project
ramps around the corner.

輝達(NVDA US)認購聯發科ECB， 有助於短期評價
與長期營運， 投資建議給Buy。

With the investment from Nvidia/Alphabet reinforcing our view on Mediatek’s strategic
ASIC opportunity, we keep our Buy rating and PO at NT$5,230 on 23x 2H27-1H28E P/E.
We believe the shares are attractive at 28x/10x '27/'28E P/E, backed by its solid
sales/earnings outlook in '26-28E at 85%/130% CAGR as operating leverage could
accelerate backed by cloud/auto ASIC projects ramp and potential in edge AI with strong
smart edge solutions.

聯發科仍為我們半導體產業首選之一，我們認為Nvidia認購聯發科大部分海
外可轉換公司債將帶來正面影響。我們維持「增加持股」評等及目標價
6,600元，對應25倍（週期高峰水準）2028年本益比，隨可轉換公司債完
成定價及AI ASIC大規模量產可望推升其評價。

Mediatek stock has been under pressure in the past 1 month (up 2% vs TWSE up
7%), due to increased concerns about competitive positioning within the GOOG
TPU foodchain, as more ASIC vendors (GUC, Alchip, Marvell) have confirmed
engagements or contracts for custom Chips with GOOG. In our view, Mediatek’s
TPU opportunity should continue to grow over the next 4-5 years and has the ability
to reach $80-100bn annual revenue run-rate by 2030E, as long as AI compute
demand remains strong. We now believe that Mediatek is likely to have majority
unit share within TPUv8 (in 2027), be the primary ASIC vendor for TPUv9 with
a sharp jump in ASPs, and is in pole position to emerge as the primary ASIC partner
for TPUv10 with rising ASP per chip. GOOG is likely to push for more control over
the ASIC design process to attempt to reduce its TCO, but the availability of high-
quality third-party IP is likely to be an impediment to rapid progress. For TPUv10,
our base case is for the business model to remain similar to TPUv9, with pure
design-service vendors such as GUC/Alchip likely engaging in the back-end
design for the compute die, while Mediatek should still provide I/O die, high-speed
Serdes and other interconnect IP, overall packaging design and program
management. We also believe the market is underestimating the operating leverage

en

All in all, we see upside to our 2028 ASIC revenue assumption, given: 1)
higher chance to win a second or even third CSP customers; 2) higher
revenue from material preparation; 3) solidified partnership with Alphabet in
TPU. Our PT of NT$5,588 implies 42% upside.

Reiterate Key Call Buy and target of NT$6,500:
Our target price is based on 27x 2027-28E PE. Maintain Key Call Buy rating.

We raise our 12M TP for MTK to TWD5,200
(previous: TWD4,088), based on our unchanged 4-quarter forward PER
target of 36x but shifting our calculation base to one-year forward EPS,
which we see as more reasonably capturing MTK’s AI ASIC contribution.
We reaffirm our Buy (1) call with key downside risks of silicon inflation and
geopolitical overhangs leading to global inflation and AI capex cut.

HEADLINE:
Jul sales of NT$48.5bn (-16.4% MoM, +12.2% YoY), tracking 31% of UBSe in Q3.
OUR TAKE:
We expect MediaTek to meet its Q3 guidance of flat to +5% QoQ. Sales growth
should re-accelerate into Q4 with ramp of Google TPU v8t and 2nm Dimensity
SoC, and we estimate Q4 sales to grow 37% QoQ.

展望聯發科技(2454.TT)未來營運重心將積極配合各大CSP 業者
開發AI 產品，2026 ~ 2027 年迎來獲利爆發期，受惠於美系CSP
客戶TPU 產品專案進入大規模量產階段，核心業務分別 HPC、
高階手機、車用電子領域拓展多元營收，預計TPU 產品營收占比
將會達到30%，整體營運動將維持強勁，帶動公司獲利持續創高。
綜合以上，研究部預估聯發科技，2027 年EPS 104.75 元，公司
切入AI ASIC 領域，給予50 倍本益比評價，目標價5240，投資
建議為買進。

聯發科本次財報及財測略優於市場共識，且公司再度上修
ASIC展望，並對ASIC生產計畫持正向態度，整體展望樂觀，
我們維持「增加持股」評等，目標價4,800元(2027年EPS x 40
倍PER)。

聯發科對2026 年手機業務看法保守，但2026~2028
年的ASIC 業務看法正向，投資建議給Trading Buy。

AI ASIC 量產時程明確、2027 年SAM（可服務市場）與市占率上修，Smart
Edge 新案放量，448G SerDes 與CPO 布局持續推進，中長期成長動能
強。預估聯發科(2454 TT)2025 年EPS 65.66 元，2026 年EPS 67.13 元，
預期2027 年AI ASIC 業務可望放量，多家資料中心客戶合作持續深化，具
營收潛力，EPS 137.9 元，建議給予本益比35 倍，設定目標價4830 元
（35X＊ 2027(F)），評等「買進」。

預估聯發科2026/2027 年EPS 為64.63/171.57 元，考量ASIC 成長
性，AI 能見度高且延續性佳，以歷史本益比區間上緣位置26 倍為評價
基礎，目標價4580 元，維持買進投資評等。
We maintain our Buy rating and PO of NT$5,230 based on 23x 2H27-1H28E P/E.

聯發科之競爭優勢為，聯發科業已在智慧型手機晶片佔有一席之
地，在WiFi-7、5G 滲透率提升之下，物聯網業務的推展會更為順
利， 再者， 受惠於運營商開始採用公司最新的無線和有線
Solution，如WiFi -7 與10 GPON， WiFi-7 Solution 優於先前的預期，
在寬頻、AP-Router 和PC/NB 等領域穩健成長，新產品陸續問世與
AI、車用長線發展將是公司長期成長動能之一。展望2026 年，預
估聯發科營收為6589.73 億元，+10.57%YoY，毛利率為46.25%，
稅後淨利為1130.15 億元，稅後EPS+70.68 元；展望2027 年，預估
聯發科年營收為11899.71 億元，+80.58%YoY，毛利率為51.01%，
稅後淨利為2464.49 億元，稅後EPS+154.07 元(對於2027 年獲利上
修約15%)。基於公司長期發展具備競爭力， 市場期待ASIC 貢獻
日增，仍給予聯發科投資建議維持買進，目標價5,395 元(35.00x
2027EPS)。

AI ASIC業務進展順利，再次上調
自4Q26年起營收貢獻，將是未來公司營運成長主軸，2027年起將明顯展現優異成長動能，投資評等調升至買進，
給予40倍PER*2027年EPS評價。

考量ASIC 業務貢獻優於預期，研究部上修獲利，預估聯發科2026 稅
後EPS 70.5 元(原預估61.23 元)，2027 年稅後EPS 132.52 元(原預估112.01 元)，
2028 年稅後EPS312.93 元。聯發科4Q26~2028 年營運由資料中心業務推動，可
望帶動明後年營運強勁成長，研究部對聯發科維持買進，目標價由3140 元調升至
5570 元(由2027~2028 年EPS 均值與25 倍評價)。

維持買進理由：
1) 定調2027 年AI 加速器ASIC 市場規模為800億美元，
調高市占率目標5 個百分點至15%~20%。
2) 下一代產品效能、ASP、市場規模更大，將於2028
年開始貢獻。

Our Jun-27 PT of NT$5300 is based on a SoTP valuation (8x
12M fwd core earnings + 30x 12M fwd ASIC-related earnings,
reflecting sluggish smartphone demand and the recent
correction in market sentiment), reflecting stronger growth in
2028 for TPU v9 Humufish.

MTK confirmed that its second AI ASIC (TPU v9, we assume) is progressing well
using EMIB-T, with further share gains and high volume production in 2028E. MTK is also
engaging with several other ASIC customers. Last but not the least, MTK has confirmed
price hikes to pass on the increased supply chain costs. Accordingly, MTK expects fullyear
GPM to be stable in the 46%+ to -1.5% range. These developments are broadly
consistent with our strengthened positive view on the company, with one modest upside –
the “implied” 4Q26E GPM guidance (at least 45-46%) appears slightly above our model
forecast of 44.7% (likely reflecting price increases offsetting the lower GPM from ASIC).
Given the in-line 3Q guidance and 2Q results, we maintain our 2026-28F EPS
forecasts and reiterate our Buy rating and TP of TWD5,800. Our TP is based on 25x 2027-
28 average EPS; the stock currently trades at 15x.

2027 年ASIC 正式放量後營收比重上升，2028 年營收占比將過半，且AI 業
務直接與Broadcom 競爭，為台廠中唯一實際跨入AI ASIC 主晶片功能設計
的IC 設計公司。將2026/2027/2028 年稅後EPS 預估上修至67.91 元
/150.30 元/269.41 元，上修幅度分別為13.5%/7.5%/10.7%，目前股價修正，
以2027/2028 年獲利計算PE 評價已降至24/13 倍，考量ASIC 業務的能見
度更高，且對聯發科的營運貢獻及成長潛力大，維持買進建議，目標價維持
5,400 元(20X 2028F EPS)。

We fine tune 2026/27E/28E EPS to NT$67.6/181.5/301.4. Our 2027/28E EPS are well
above consensus by 39%/19%. MediaTek's higher conviction on TPU opportunity,
especially the TPU v9 progress, should ease investor concerns on execution. Reiterate
Key Call Buy and target of NT$6,500, based on 27x 2027-28E PE.

1. 穩健的2Q26財報，3Q26展望 
2. 400G SerDes IP預計於2H27準備就緒，令人驚喜 
3. 旗艦智慧型手機中的Agentic運算預計於2027、2028年成為另一亮點

因：(1)2Q26財報優於預期，(2)3Q26財測優於市場預期，(3)26年
全年營收財測上修，(3)再度上修AI ASIC市場值，也再度上修聯
發科的市占率，(4)上修26年的CSP AI ASIC貢獻性，27-28年

元(原估65.1元，+0.5%YOY)，並上修27年EPS預估為121.05元

27-28年將超過手機，故以27-28年平均EPS的25XPER，目標價

MediaTek hosted its 2Q26 analyst meeting on 31 July. 3Q26 
guidance came in better than expected, and the company has 
delivered an even more positive message on its AI ASIC business, 
which we believe further reinforces our view that the AI ASIC 
upcycle is just getting started. Management now expects its AI ASIC 
revenue to exceed US$2bn in 2026 (vs. US$2bn previously) and 
raised its 2027 AI ASIC SAM and market share — which now 
implies US$12-$16bn of AI ASIC revenue in 2027 (vs. US$7-$12bn 
previously). Management expressed its confidence in its next-gen AI 
ASIC project, stating that the tapeout is on track, with high 
volume production planned for early 2028. Packaging and 
substrate yields are also progressing well, which we believe should 
ease investor concerns around execution. Management now expects 
its first AI ASIC project will also contribute in 2028 along with its 
second project, which is expected to enhance the company’s 
market share significantly. With a stronger near- and 
medium-term outlook driven by AI ASIC business, we reiterate our 
Buy rating on MediaTek and tick up our 12m TP to NT$7,000 (25X 
on 2H27-1H28E EPS) from NT$6,800, implying potential upside of 
~97%.

With near term business and ASIC progress largely in line with our preview, we keep our
‘26/27/28 EPS at NT$68.61/NT$137.76/NT$347.25. Reiterate our Buy rating and PO at
NT$5,230 on 23x 2H27-1H28E P/E. Following the recent pullback, the share is attractive
at 25x/10x '27/'28E P/E (vs. its P/E range of 8-25x), backed by its solid sales/earnings
outlook in '26-28E at 85%/130% CAGR as operating leverage could accelerate backed by
cloud/auto ASIC projects ramp and potential in edge AI with strong smart edge solutions.

Cloud+Edge AI to support long term growth; reiterate Buy: We believe Mediatek
is well-positioned in both edge and cloud AI and expect AI accelerator ASIC to see
multiple growth in the next 2-3 years. Our TP is raised to NT$6,800.

維持「增加持股」評等及目標價6,600元，對應25倍 (週期高峰水準) 2028
年本益比。聯發科也是凱基在半導體的首選之一。

MediaTek (MTK) released upbeat 2Q26 results but downbeat
3Q26 guidance. Though the cash-cow mobile business looks to be
weakening on commodity cost inflation, its new AI business appears to be
running ahead of expectation. We raise our AI accelerator assumption and
expect MTK’s AI ASIC revenue contribution to overtake Mobile in mid-2027,
a year earlier than our previous forecast. Aided by the recent reset of equity
market’s hefty expectation unlocking value for reinvestment, in our view, we
upgrade our rating 2 notches to Buy (1) with a refreshed TP of TWD4,088.

On better than guided 2Q26 sales and firmer ASIC design and production progress, we 
lift our ‘26/27/28E EPS by 1-3% to NT$67.67/NT$137.87/NT$346.11. We reiterate our 
Buy rating and raise PO from NT$5,100 to NT$5,230 based on the same 23x 2H27-
1H28E P/E. Following the recent pullback, the shares trade at an attractive 27x/11x 
'27/'28E P/E (vs. its historical P/E range of 8-25x), backed by its solid sales/earnings 
outlook in '26-28E at 85%/130% CAGR as cloud ASICs inflect. Upcoming earnings call 
focus: tech end market outlook, ASIC TAM/share, chipset price and GMs amid cost hike
across the chain.

MediaTek's TPU 8t visibility continues to improve, with the ASIC opportunity
extending into a multiyear growth story through 2029. Its ASIC guidance remains
conservative compared to our forecast of US$16bn for 2027, and we see scope for
the guidance to be raised as the ramp progresses. We believe 2Q26 is the last
earnings call before TPU contribution becomes visible, and we expect
management's commentary to turn more constructive as mass production
approaches and 2027 capacity negotiations are largely finalised. We raise 26/27SP
EPS by 6%/5% to reflect strong smart edge business and the higher TPU
contribution. Maintain TP of NT$5,922 and reiterate High Conviction Outperform.

Maintain price target NT$5,588 and industry Top Pick: This implies 18x for 2028e
EPS. We think that's still attractive vs. its 2025-28e revenue CAGR of >50%.

重申買進評等，維持目標價6,000元，預期上漲56%：
1. 近期的疲弱提供了穩健的再進場時機 
2. Google TAM更新，有望將客製化ASIC市場占有率目標提升至15-20% 
3. 另一個客戶/專案可能稍後出現

維持「增加持股」評等及目標價6,150元，對應25倍 (週期高峰水準) 2028
年本益比。聯發科也是凱基在半導體的首選之一。

We expect MediaTek’s tone in its upcoming 2Q26 earnings call (Jul 31) to be quite
upbeat on ASIC, while being incrementally more guarded on near-term
smartphone demand. We believe that ASIC revenues in 2027 (from TPU v8t
Zebrafish) should see upside, given better supply conditions for substrate and
CoWoS-wafers, while confidence in the ramp of TPUv9 Humufish is also likely
to strengthen. MediaTek is likely to mention new customer engagements (likely
SpaceX in our view) as well as continuation of its engagement with Google in TPU
v10 projects. Smartphone demand remains challenging, and guidance for
smartphones is likely to remain sub-seasonal in 3Q26, with some pressure on Gross
Margins. We raise our 2028 EPS by 20% to reflect stronger TPUv9 prospects and
stay OW with a Jun-27 PT of NT$5300 (10x 12M fwd core earnings + 33x 12M
fwd ASIC-related earnings).

HEADLINE:
Q2 sales in NT$ +2% QoQ beat high-end of guidance (flat to -6% QoQ).
OUR TAKE:
Q2 sales was supported by resiliency of smart edge products which offset
smartphone decline. We forecast Q3 sales to be +1% QoQ w/ 46.1% GM. Google
TPU v8t should be on-track for mass production in H226 to meet US$2bn
guidance.

In light of the stronger AI ASIC outlook and higher pricing, we revise 
up 2027-28E EPS by 38%/4%. Net net, we are now modeling 
MediaTek’s 2027-28E revenue to grow by 95%/83% YoY (vs. 
61%/111% previously) with OpM expanding to 25%/33% (vs. 15% 
in 2026E), and EPS of NT$181.92/NT$422.17 in 2027/28E. We 
raise our 12m TP to NT$6,800 from NT$5,000 (still based on 25x 
2H27-1H28E EPS). With 57% implied upside, we reiterate our Buy 
rating on MediaTek.

Reiterate our Buy rating with a higher TP of TWD5,800:
MediaTek’s share price has entirely reversed its multi-year underperformance from April
2026 (see our 31 March upgrade report, After 2000 days... ), with the share price up nearly
3x (up 160% vs. TAIEX up 41%) over the past three months — mainly driven by the
company’s solid messaging about its TPU project (guiding up 2026 contribution to be above
USD2bn from USD1bn, and pulling forward its ASIC market share target from 2028E to
2027E, during the company’s April earnings call) and TSMC’s (2330 TT, Buy) growing
capacity allocation, we think. We have received questions on whether this bright outlook is
priced in following the record-level share price surge, but it looks to us that potential upside
remains ample. We raise our 2026-28F earnings forecasts by 9-96% with a higher TP of
TWD5,800 (vs TWD3,400 previously) based on an unchanged 25x target P/E applied to our
2027-28F average EPS. The stock now trades at 16.7x average 2027-28F EPS.

unchanged 35x 2028E PER. We justify this multiple based on our estimate
for a 63% EPS CAGR over 2025-28.

Raise price target to NT$5,588: This implies P/Es 38x for 2027 and 18x for 2028e
EPS, based on our increase estimates .We think that's still attractive vs. its 2025-28e

We fine-tune EPS for 2026E and raise estimates for 2027E and beyond by 10-16% to 
reflect the improving business outlook for existing products and a larger TPU 
opportunity. Our 2027/28E EPS estimates are 46%/30% above consensus, as we believe 
consensus still underestimates upside in sales and profit from TPU projects, and has not 
factored in the share gains in Samsung's flagship models. We lift our price target from 
NT$5,500 to NT$6,500, based on 27x average 2027-28E PE (from 26x). We believe a 
27x target PE is now justified, given: 1) its 27% long-term earnings CAGR supports a 1x 
PEG, consistent across our semis coverage; and 2) it is close to the high end of its 15-year 
trading range (10-30x), which we think is justified by its more diversified and stronger 
growth drivers. With the stock currently trading at 24.7x/14.9x 2027/28E PE, we see 
room for a further re-rating. Maintain Key Call Buy rating.

我們維持買進評等，並進一步將目標股價上調至6,000
元，以反映其在TPU V9設計中的更高參與度。此外，Meta Arke專案即將決
定，並將成為2028年度另一項成長動能。

憑藉對先進製程的深厚理解、與領先晶圓代工廠們的緊密合作關係，以及靈
活的商業模式，我們認為聯發科有望重新定位為CSP在分散供應來源時的最
佳ASIC合作夥伴，因此具備評價重估的機會。我們將目標價上調至6,150
元，基於25倍2028年EPS；該目標價尚未反映任何評價重估，僅反映我們
對獲利預估的上修。維持「增加持股」評等。

Stay OW, maintain Top Pick: This reflects the company's strong technology and
execution in Cloud AI ASIC design services. Edge AI also has strong potential.

Mediatek traditionally traded only at mid-teens PE valuation on
smartphone and consumer electronics product cycle. With it transforming
to AI ASIC play with AI ASIC contribution to reach c38% in two years, it will
cover from edge AI to cloud AI. While smartphone business may continue to
be muted into 2H26, we see increasing possibility that Mediatek would
penetrate Samsung’s high-end smartphone SoC into 2027. We reiterate
Buy on Mediatek but lift our TP to NT$5,950 with higher PER of 36x of
2027/2028 EPS on the back of its AI business upside.

We estimate Google TPU to account for 38% and 63% of

marking one of the most dynamic growth phases in the company’s history, with ASIC 
potentially contributing up to one-third of total revenue. In this note, we also highlight the 
forthcoming Google/MTK TPU – “HumuFish”. The new TPU could deliver 3-5x the content

advancement. Such a breakthrough positions MTK to transition from a consumer-oriented 
supplier to a leading AI-centric partner, paving the way for a rerating of its valuation 
multiple. MTK remains our top pick in the AI accelerator space. Key risks include potential 
adoption of COT (unlikely before 2029), execution challenges, and demand uncertainty in 
the consumer markets.

投資人對AI半導體成長動能有疑慮，摩根士丹利證券（大摩）釋出報告指出，雲端服務供應商（CSP）在2028年的資本支出預估成長約12%，但AI半導體的支出增幅更高。台積電（2330）、英特爾、輝達、超微等關鍵廠商將持續受惠，聯發科（2454）透過與輝達NVLink Fusion合作，也有望受惠。根據大摩最新的供應鏈調查，2028年CoWoS/CoPoS/EMIB-T產能初步估計將成長50%，基礎設施（例如廠房與AI資料中心）支出持平，2028 年記憶體價格溫和成長。在CoWoS方面，大摩預期台積電及封測合作夥伴將加快CoWoS的產能擴張計畫。台積電CoWoS產能將從2026年的每月13萬片、2027年的每月20萬片，進一步到2028年擴大到每月26萬片，其中2028年的擴張主要集中在亞利桑那州的AP9/10廠，也可能包括在嘉義的AP7廠。大摩指出，AI繪圖處理器（GPU）相關的生產都將交由台積電的CoWoS，而超微MI455/450將是2027年的主要焦點，MI500系列（晶片代號 Arcadia）則預估在2027年底少量生產。MI455與MI450產能都可能達到約50–65萬顆。大摩估計台積電CoWoS-L的總訂單在2027年將年增200%，達到21萬片。由於封測廠的產能提升較緩慢，台積電每月有8萬片的CoWoS-L產能將用來生產超微Venice，這多少擠壓了AI GPU的產能。在CoPoS方面，大摩指出，台積電目前正在桃園進行CoPoS的試產。只要進展順利，預期台積電將開始建置CoPoS產能，地點很可能在AP9/10或AP7P3廠。台積電的CoPoS產能在2028年預計將達每月5–10萬片，並在2029年達到每月10–20萬片，但仍要取決於試產的結果。大摩預估，台積電AI相關營收在2024-2029年的年複合成長率（CAGR）可能達60%，對台積電維持「優於大盤」評等，目標價為2,988元。
內外資逆勢加碼股抗震 聯發科、南亞科等各擁題材獲買盤力挺

投資人擔心美國聯準會（Fed）將於本周升息，台股高檔動盪，法人對台股轉為賣超。不過，統計顯示，聯發科（2454）、南亞科（2408）、華邦電（2344）、力積電（6770）等14檔個股受到內外資法人同步買超加持，抗震力強。依CMoney資料，內外資上周同步買超金額前14檔，包括聯發科、南亞科、華邦電、力積電、欣興、友達、臻鼎-KY、致茂、中華電、大量、愛普*、第一金、世界、聯詠等14檔個股。在內外資都重金逆勢加碼的這14檔個股中，有12檔是電子股，包括七檔半導體股、兩檔電子零組件股，以及光電、其他電子、通信網路股各一檔；兩檔非電子股則是電機機械與金融股各一檔。這些個股股價表現不一，但普遍優於大盤0.7%的單周跌幅。相形之下，三大法人上周同步賣超的台達電、緯穎、世芯-KY、華通、環球晶、光寶科、貿聯-KY等，股價單周跌幅從8%到13.5%不等。三大法人上周同步買超最多的個股是聯發科，買超5,029張、金額達237.3億元，激勵股價單周逆勢漲3.8%。聯發科利多頻傳，8月營收創新高、與輝達全面升級合作夥伴關係、發行海外可轉換公司債（ECB）有近九成獲輝達砸35億美元認購、將推出新一代天璣旗艦晶片等。外資法人給聯發科的目標價大都超過6,000元，甚至上看萬元。記憶體漲價題材受內外資同步肯定，南亞科上周獲得三大法人合計買超2.8萬張、約155.9億元，華邦電則獲買超4.6萬張、92.8億元。華邦電8月營收創歷史新高，南亞科則為50個月新高，法人預期營收將持續受惠於漲價效應。成熟製程同樣受惠於漲價題材，力積電及世界上周也獲內外資買超加持。在電子零組件族群中，則以印刷電路板（PCB）大廠欣興及臻鼎-KY最受法人青睞，上周股價分別上漲8.3%、6.9%。另外，大量雖然歸類為電機機械股，但供應PCB設備，也受惠於AI伺服器商機，獲得內外資法人同步買超肯定。在這些電子及類電子股中，唯一的金融股是第一金，獲得三大法人同步買進，上周股價漲4.2%。第一金前八月獲利創新高，且是長期存股族的最愛，也反映部分法人資金轉向高殖利率股。
